title: Phase7b arm A target 7 (KOR): no experience store, derive the approach from first principles
text:
Goal: build the most reliable binding-activity predictor for KOR and produce a top-100 ranking of the 100k library.

Constraints:
- labels: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/oprk1/ki/dataset_p7b.csv (read-only). Molecules reserved for the locked test set have already been removed from this file, so everything you see is yours to train on.
- library: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/zinc/library_100k.smi
- FROZEN SPLIT: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/oprk1/ki/splits/frozen_oprk1.json
  Pass this exact path as `--split-manifest` to ml.train. Do NOT call data.split, and do not pick your own fractions: every arm is scored on this one manifest so the numbers are comparable.
- there is NO experience store in this arm and no experience.retrieve tool: derive the approach from first principles
- locked evaluation (REQUIRED): when you have a final model, call evaluation.locked exactly once with --target KOR --endpoint Ki --desc-set <the descriptor set you trained on> and --receipt evaluation/kor_locked.json. The receipt holds the AUROC that counts; report it verbatim.
- this is target #7 in a sequence of 9.

You may choose representation, model family, and fusion.

Deliverable: report with
  (a) choices and rationale,
  (b) frozen-split validation AUROC/AUPRC/EF@1%,
  (c) the locked-test AUROC from evaluation/kor_locked.json (quote it),
  (d) top-100 path,
  (e) cost (wall clock, jobs),
  (f) which experience_id(s) you used, and what you reused verbatim versus adapted.
